chat_decision_checkpoint.source_evidence: AI Core adopted main design and Current #1; exact PR3 checkout 75778b66 clean, Docker contract and stopped backends in https://github.com/seigo-gace/ai-core/issues/1#issuecomment-6222466218. Read-only final safety check for UDS cutover.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/admin1/projects/ai-core
w="$r/.worktrees/pr3-verification-20261015"
envfile=NO; [ -f "$r/.env" ] && envfile=YES
oldcompose=NO; [ -f "$r/compose.runtime.yml" ] && oldcompose=YES
models=$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/models"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' ai-coder)
modelmatch=NO; [ "$models" = "$r/models" ] && modelmatch=YES
newcfg=FAIL; docker compose -p ai-core -f "$w/compose.runtime.yml" --project-directory "$r" config -q >/dev/null 2>&1 && newcfg=PASS
gatecfg=FAIL; if [ "$envfile" = YES ]; then docker compose -p ai-core-gate -f "$w/compose.gate.yml" --project-directory "$r" --env-file "$r/.env" config -q >/dev/null 2>&1 && gatecfg=PASS; fi
lease=$(docker exec ai-core-model-gate python3 -c 'import os,json,urllib.request; q=urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:18184/internal/handoff/status",headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+os.environ["AI_CORE_API_KEY"]}); d=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(q,timeout=8)); print("EMPTY" if not(d["resident"] or any(d["active"].values()) or d["handoff"] or d["recovery_pending"]) else "BUSY")' 2>/dev/null || echo ERROR)
report="AI_CORE_UDS_FINAL_SAFETY_PREFLIGHT
ENVFILE=$envfile
ROLLBACK_COMPOSE=$oldcompose
MODELS_MOUNT_MATCH=$modelmatch
NEW_BACKEND_COMPOSE=$newcfg
NEW_GATE_COMPOSE=$gatecfg
CURRENT_LEASE=$lease"
printf '%s\n' "$report"
gh api -X POST repos/seigo-gace/ai-core/issues/1/comments -f "body=$report" --jq .html_url
